    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Linux程序性能分析（一）---perf原理分析</span>

<p><font color="red" size="7">PS：要转载请注明出处，本人版权所有。</font><br><br>

<h6 id="环境说明">环境说明</h6>
<p>  无</p>
<h3 id="前言">前言</h3>
<hr>
<p>  前段时间做了很多的基于sdk/demo的大模型程序性能评估，例如一个大模型运行的瓶颈是什么？这里的评估要分为两个部分：</p>
<ul>
<li>异构设备运行性能评估：异构设备的执行时间，例如高通的NSP设备的运行一个模型的性能评估。</li>
<li>cpu运行性能评估：sdk/demo执行一次模型推理的性能评估。</li>
</ul>
<p>  对于异构设备来说（例如高通dsp，运行高通自己的rtos），有他专门的profile工具。对于cpu设备来说（Linux系统），有一个常用的性能评估工具，就是perf。</p>
<p>  对于perf来说，我相信只要是做开发的，多多少少都听过火焰图这个概念，而构建火焰图的一个重要前提是，我们需要通过perf来对目标进程进行cpu cycle采样，然后基于这个采样获取ip/tid/cpu核/callchain等信息。perf除了支持cpu cycle采样外，还支持其他的各种各样的性能参数采样。</p>
<p>  以前，用perf来做性能分析，只知道能获取这些信息，但是怎么获取的，一知半解。因此，趁着这个机会，基于linux-7.1.6的内核源码，以采集cpu cycle为例，本文尝试从用户态、内核态两个角度来分析perf实现的基本原理。</p>
<br>
<br>
<br>
<br>
<h3 id="perf-用户态实现原理">perf 用户态实现原理</h3>
<hr>
<p>  这里我在AI的辅助下，实现了一个和perf工具非常相似的例子，可以传入pid，对目标进程进行采样，获取ip/tid/cpu核/callchain等信息。</p>
<p>  下面是一些代码片段分析：<br>
perf_event.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">#include "perf_event.h"

#include &lt;linux/perf_event.h&gt;
#include &lt;sys/ioctl.h&gt;
#include &lt;sys/syscall.h&gt;
#include &lt;unistd.h&gt;
#include &lt;errno.h&gt;

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/*  low-level syscall wrapper                                         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
static long
_perf_event_open(const struct perf_event_attr *attr,
                 pid_t                         pid,
                 int                           cpu,
                 int                           group_fd,
                 unsigned long                 flags)
{
    return syscall(__NR_perf_event_open, attr, pid, cpu, group_fd, flags);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/*  public API                                                        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

int
perf_open(const struct perf_event_attr *attr,
          pid_t                         pid,
          int                           cpu,
          int                           group_fd,
          unsigned long                 flags)
{
    if (attr == NULL) {
        errno = EINVAL;
        return -1;
    }
    return (int) _perf_event_open(attr, pid, cpu, group_fd, flags);
}

void
perf_close(int fd)
{
    if (fd &gt;= 0) {
        close(fd);
    }
}

int
perf_start(int fd)
{
    if (fd &lt; 0) {
        errno = EINVAL;
        return -1;
    }
    if (ioctl(fd, PERF_EVENT_IOC_RESET, 0) &lt; 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (ioctl(fd, PERF_EVENT_IOC_ENABLE, 0) &lt; 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int
perf_stop(int fd, uint64_t *count)
{
    if (fd &lt; 0) {
        errno = EINVAL;
        return -1;
    }
    if (ioctl(fd, PERF_EVENT_IOC_DISABLE, 0) &lt; 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    uint64_t val = 0;
    ssize_t  n   = read(fd, &amp;val, sizeof(val));
    if (n != sizeof(val)) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (count != NULL) {
        *count = val;
    }
    return 0;
}

</code></pre>
<p>perf_event.h</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">#ifndef PERF_EVENT_H
#define PERF_EVENT_H

#include &lt;linux/perf_event.h&gt;
#include &lt;stdint.h&gt;
#include &lt;unistd.h&gt;

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/*
 * perf_open  –  open a perf event counter.
 *
 * Direct wrapper for the perf_event_open(2) syscall — all parameters are
 * passed through unchanged.
 *
 *   attr     : fully initialised perf_event_attr.
 *   pid      : pid to monitor (0 = calling thread, -1 = all threads).
 *   cpu      : cpu to monitor (-1 = any cpu).
 *   group_fd : group leader fd (-1 to create a new group).
 *   flags    : PERF_FLAG_FD_NO_GROUP, PERF_FLAG_FD_OUTPUT, etc. (0 for none).
 *
 *   Returns fd &gt;= 0 on success, -1 on failure (errno is set).
 */
int perf_open(const struct perf_event_attr *attr,
              pid_t                         pid,
              int                           cpu,
              int                           group_fd,
              unsigned long                 flags);

/*
 * perf_close –  close a perf event fd.  No-op when fd &lt; 0.
 */
void perf_close(int fd);

/*
 * perf_start –  reset counter to zero and enable.  Returns 0 / -1.
 */
int perf_start(int fd);

/*
 * perf_stop  –  disable counter and read accumulated value into *count.
 *               Returns 0 / -1.
 */
int perf_stop(int fd, uint64_t *count);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* PERF_EVENT_H */

</code></pre>
<p>perf_ringbuf.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">#include "perf_ringbuf.h"

#include &lt;linux/perf_event.h&gt;
#include &lt;sys/mman.h&gt;
#include &lt;unistd.h&gt;
#include &lt;stdint.h&gt;
#include &lt;stddef.h&gt;

int
perf_ringbuf_open(int fd,
                  int nr_pages,
                  void **base,
                  struct perf_event_mmap_page **meta,
                  size_t *data_size)
{
    if (base == NULL || meta == NULL || data_size == NULL || nr_pages &lt; 1) {
        return -1;
    }

    long   page_size = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
    size_t mmap_size = (1 + (size_t) nr_pages) * page_size;

    void *addr = mmap(NULL, mmap_size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
                      MAP_SHARED, fd, 0);
    if (addr == MAP_FAILED) {
        return -1;
    }

    *base      = addr;
    *meta      = (struct perf_event_mmap_page *) addr;
    *data_size = (size_t) nr_pages * page_size;
    return 0;
}

void
perf_ringbuf_head_tail(const struct perf_event_mmap_page *meta,
                       uint64_t *head,
                       uint64_t *tail)
{
    uint64_t h = meta-&gt;data_head;
    __sync_synchronize();
    uint64_t t = meta-&gt;data_tail;
    if (head != NULL) {
        *head = h;
    }
    if (tail != NULL) {
        *tail = t;
    }
}

void
perf_ringbuf_close(void *base, size_t data_size)
{
    if (base == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    long page_size  = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
    long mmap_size  = page_size + (long) data_size;
    munmap(base, mmap_size);
}

</code></pre>
<p>perf_ringbuf.h</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">#ifndef PERF_RINGBUF_H
#define PERF_RINGBUF_H

#include &lt;linux/perf_event.h&gt;
#include &lt;stddef.h&gt;
#include &lt;stdint.h&gt;

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/*
 * perf_ringbuf_open – mmap the perf event ring buffer.
 *
 *   fd        : perf event file descriptor.
 *   nr_pages  : number of data pages (must be power-of-2, usually 8).
 *   base      : [out] mmap base address (metadata page).
 *   meta      : [out] pointer to struct perf_event_mmap_page.
 *   data_size : [out] size of data area in bytes (= nr_pages * page_size).
 *
 *   Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.
 */
int perf_ringbuf_open(int fd,
                      int nr_pages,
                      void **base,
                      struct perf_event_mmap_page **meta,
                      size_t *data_size);

/*
 * perf_ringbuf_head_tail – read head and tail with correct memory barrier.
 *   Caller must pass the meta pointer from perf_ringbuf_open.
 *   head is written by the kernel, tail is written by userspace.
 */
void perf_ringbuf_head_tail(const struct perf_event_mmap_page *meta,
                            uint64_t *head,
                            uint64_t *tail);

/*
 * perf_ringbuf_close – munmap the ring buffer.
 *
 *   base      : the base address returned by perf_ringbuf_open.
 *   data_size : the data_size value returned by perf_ringbuf_open.
 */
void perf_ringbuf_close(void *base, size_t data_size);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* PERF_RINGBUF_H */

</code></pre>
<p>demo_sample.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">#define _GNU_SOURCE

#include "perf_event.h"
#include "perf_ringbuf.h"

#include &lt;linux/perf_event.h&gt;
#include &lt;sys/mman.h&gt;
#include &lt;sys/ioctl.h&gt;

#include &lt;unistd.h&gt;
#include &lt;stdint.h&gt;
#include &lt;stdio.h&gt;
#include &lt;stdlib.h&gt;
#include &lt;string.h&gt;
#include &lt;errno.h&gt;
#include &lt;dlfcn.h&gt;
#include &lt;poll.h&gt;
#include &lt;time.h&gt;

#define SAMPLE_COUNT   10
#define MAX_MAPS       512

/* ── memory map entry ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct {
    uint64_t start;
    uint64_t end;
    char     path[256];
} mem_map_t;

static mem_map_t maps[MAX_MAPS];
static int       nr_maps;

/* ── helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* read value at ptr, then advance ptr by sizeof(raw_type) */
#define NEXT_FIELD(ptr, raw_type) \
    (*(raw_type *)(ptr)); (ptr) = (void *)((char *)(ptr) + sizeof(raw_type))

/* ── parse /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/maps ───────────────────────────────────────── */
static int
parse_maps(pid_t pid)
{
    char path[64];
    snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "/proc/%d/maps", pid);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (f == NULL) {
        perror("fopen /proc/.../maps");
        return -1;
    }

    nr_maps = 0;
    char line[512];
    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f) != NULL &amp;&amp; nr_maps &lt; MAX_MAPS) {
        uint64_t start, end;
        char perms[8], fpath[256] = {0};

        /* format: start-end perms offset dev inode path */
        int n = sscanf(line, "%lx-%lx %7s %*s %*s %*u %255s",
                       &amp;start, &amp;end, perms, fpath);

        if (n &lt; 2) continue;   /* skip malformed lines */

        maps[nr_maps].start = start;
        maps[nr_maps].end   = end;

        if (n &gt;= 4 &amp;&amp; fpath[0] != '\0') {
            /* keep only the basename */
            const char *name = strrchr(fpath, '/');
            snprintf(maps[nr_maps].path, sizeof(maps[nr_maps].path),
                     "%s", name ? name + 1 : fpath);
        } else {
            /* anonymous mapping – try to identify by permissions */
            if (strchr(perms, 'x')) {
                snprintf(maps[nr_maps].path, sizeof(maps[nr_maps].path),
                         "[anon_exec:%lx]", start);
            } else {
                snprintf(maps[nr_maps].path, sizeof(maps[nr_maps].path),
                         "[anon]");
            }
        }
        nr_maps++;
    }
    fclose(f);
    return 0;
}

/* ── look up which mapping an address falls into ──────────────────── */
static const mem_map_t *
find_map(uint64_t addr)
{
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; nr_maps; i++) {
        if (addr &gt;= maps[i].start &amp;&amp; addr &lt; maps[i].end) {
            return &amp;maps[i];
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* ── resolve symbol name ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
/*
 * When pid == our own process  →  use dladdr(3) to get function names.
 * When pid != self              →  fall back to /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/maps and
 *                                    print &lt;binary&gt;+&lt;offset&gt;.
 */
static void
resolve_symbol(pid_t my_pid, pid_t target_pid, uint64_t addr,
               char *buf, size_t bufsz)
{
    /* dladdr only works for addresses in our own address space */
    if (target_pid == my_pid || target_pid == 0) {
        Dl_info info;
        if (dladdr((void *) (uintptr_t) addr, &amp;info) != 0) {
            const char *name = info.dli_sname ? info.dli_sname : "???";
            uint64_t   off   = addr - (uint64_t) (uintptr_t) info.dli_saddr;
            const char *file = info.dli_fname ? info.dli_fname : "???";
            const char *base = strrchr(file, '/');
            snprintf(buf, bufsz, "%s+0x%lx (%s)",
                     name, off, base ? base + 1 : file);
            return;
        }
        /* dladdr failed – fall through to maps-based lookup */
    }

    /* kernel-space address */
    if (addr &gt;= 0xffff000000000000ULL) {
        snprintf(buf, bufsz, "[kernel]");
        return;
    }

    /* maps-based fallback for cross-process or dladdr failure */
    const mem_map_t *m = find_map(addr);
    if (m != NULL) {
        uint64_t off = addr - m-&gt;start;
        snprintf(buf, bufsz, "%s+0x%lx", m-&gt;path, off);
    } else {
        snprintf(buf, bufsz, "[nomap:0x%lx]", addr);
    }
}

/* ── usage ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void
usage(const char *prog)
{
    fprintf(stderr, "Usage: %s [pid]\n", prog);
    fprintf(stderr, "  pid  – monitor &lt;pid&gt; (default: 0 = calling thread)\n");
}

/* =================================================================== */
int
main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
    pid_t target_pid = 0;    /* default: own thread */
    pid_t my_pid     = getpid();

    if (argc &gt; 1) {
        if (strcmp(argv[1], "-h") == 0 || strcmp(argv[1], "--help") == 0) {
            usage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        }
        target_pid = (pid_t) atoi(argv[1]);
    }

    /* ── parse /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/maps for symbol resolution ── */
    pid_t maps_pid = (target_pid == 0) ? my_pid : target_pid;
    if (parse_maps(maps_pid) != 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    printf("loaded %d memory mappings for pid %d\n", nr_maps, maps_pid);

    /* ── perf event attr ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
    struct perf_event_attr attr;
    memset(&amp;attr, 0, sizeof(attr));

    attr.size           = sizeof(attr);
    attr.type           = PERF_TYPE_HARDWARE;
    attr.config         = PERF_COUNT_HW_CPU_CYCLES;
    attr.sample_period  = 10000;
    attr.disabled       = 1;
    attr.exclude_kernel = 0;
    attr.exclude_hv     = 1;
    attr.wakeup_events  = 1;
    /* Note: inherit=1 would cover forked children but prevents mmap on
     *       older ARM kernels.  Use pid=&lt;tgid&gt; to cover all threads. */

    attr.sample_type =
        PERF_SAMPLE_IP |
        PERF_SAMPLE_TID |
        PERF_SAMPLE_TIME |
        PERF_SAMPLE_CPU |
        PERF_SAMPLE_CALLCHAIN;

    attr.sample_max_stack = 20;

    /* ── 1. perf_open ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    int fd = perf_open(&amp;attr, target_pid, -1, -1, 0);
    if (fd &lt; 0) {
        perror("perf_open");
        return -1;
    }
    printf("perf fd=%d  target_pid=%d\n", fd, target_pid);

    /* ── 2. perf_ringbuf_open ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    void                          *base;
    struct perf_event_mmap_page   *meta;
    size_t                         data_size;

    if (perf_ringbuf_open(fd, 8, &amp;base, &amp;meta, &amp;data_size) != 0) {
        perror("perf_ringbuf_open");
        perf_close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    long page_size = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
    char *data = (char *) base + page_size;

    printf("page_size=%ld  data_size=%zu\n", page_size, data_size);
    printf("start sampling (%d samples)...\n", SAMPLE_COUNT);

    /* ── 3. perf_start ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    if (perf_start(fd) != 0) {
        perror("perf_start");
        perf_ringbuf_close(base, data_size);
        perf_close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    /* ── produce workload and collect N samples ───────────────────── */
    int sample_count = 0;
    int is_self = (target_pid == 0 || target_pid == my_pid);

    struct pollfd pfd = { .fd = fd, .events = POLLIN };

    /*
     * Self-monitoring: we must burn CPU ourselves to generate PMU events.
     *   → poll with short timeout, burn CPU in between.
     *
     * Cross-process: the target generates events; we just wait passively.
     *   → poll blocks until data arrives or total timeout expires.
     */
    int   poll_timeout = is_self ? 10 : 5000;   /* ms */
    struct timespec t_start, t_now;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &amp;t_start);

    volatile unsigned long x = 0;

    while (sample_count &lt; SAMPLE_COUNT) {
        if (is_self) {
            /* burn CPU while waiting for poll — generates our own samples */
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; 200000; i++) {
                x += i;
            }
        }

        int ret = poll(&amp;pfd, 1, poll_timeout);
        if (ret &lt; 0) {
            perror("poll");
            break;
        }

        if (ret == 0) {
            /* timeout: check total elapsed (safety against infinite hang) */
            clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &amp;t_now);
            double elapsed = (t_now.tv_sec  - t_start.tv_sec) +
                             (t_now.tv_nsec - t_start.tv_nsec) / 1e9;
            if (elapsed &gt;= 30.0) {
                printf("\ntimeout after %.0fs, collected %d samples\n",
                       elapsed, sample_count);
                break;
            }
            continue;
        }

        /* fd is readable — drain the ring buffer */
        uint64_t head, tail;
        perf_ringbuf_head_tail(meta, &amp;head, &amp;tail);

        while (tail &lt; head) {
            size_t  offset = tail &amp; (data_size - 1);
            struct perf_event_header *header =
                (struct perf_event_header *) (data + offset);

            if (header-&gt;type == PERF_RECORD_SAMPLE) {
                sample_count++;

                void *p = (char *) header +
                    sizeof(struct perf_event_header);

                /* kernel output order (fixed, not sorted by bit):
                 *   IP, TID, TIME, ID, CPU, CALLCHAIN(no nr, fills rest)
                 */
                uint64_t ip   = NEXT_FIELD(p, uint64_t);
                uint32_t pid  = NEXT_FIELD(p, uint32_t);
                uint32_t tid  = NEXT_FIELD(p, uint32_t);
                uint64_t time = NEXT_FIELD(p, uint64_t);
                uint64_t id   = NEXT_FIELD(p, uint64_t);
                uint32_t cpu  = NEXT_FIELD(p, uint32_t);
          (void) NEXT_FIELD(p, uint32_t);  /* reserved */

                char   *record_end = (char *) header + header-&gt;size;
                uint64_t nr = ((uint64_t)(record_end - (char *) p))
                              / sizeof(uint64_t);
                uint64_t *ips = (uint64_t *) p;

                char sym[256];

                printf("\n--- sample %d/%d ---\n", sample_count, SAMPLE_COUNT);
                resolve_symbol(my_pid, target_pid, ip, sym, sizeof(sym));
                printf("IP       = 0x%lx  %s\n", ip, sym);
                printf("PID      = %u\n",       pid);
                printf("TID      = %u\n",       tid);
                printf("TIME     = %lu\n",      time);
                printf("ID       = %lu\n",      id);
                printf("CPU      = %u\n",       cpu);
                printf("CALLCHAIN (%lu frames):\n", nr);
                for (uint64_t i = 0; i &lt; nr; i++) {
                    resolve_symbol(my_pid, target_pid, ips[i], sym, sizeof(sym));
                    printf("  [%lu] 0x%lx  %s\n", i, ips[i], sym);
                }

                if (sample_count &gt;= SAMPLE_COUNT) {
                    tail += header-&gt;size;
                    meta-&gt;data_tail = tail;
                    goto done;
                }
            }

            tail += header-&gt;size;
            meta-&gt;data_tail = tail;
        }
    }
done:

    /* ── 4. perf_stop ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    uint64_t count;
    perf_stop(fd, &amp;count);
    printf("\nfinal count = %lu\n", count);

    /* ── 5,6. cleanup ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    perf_ringbuf_close(base, data_size);
    perf_close(fd);

    return 0;
}

</code></pre>
<p>上面的代码有几个重要的关注点：</p>
<ol>
<li>首先，perf的核心就是调用syscall __NR_perf_event_open(perf_event.c)，调用的时候，传入对应的想采样的数据类型、采样模式等参数即可，然后得到了一个fd。</li>
<li>在我们开始采样之前，我们还需要通过上面的fd+mmap申请一片空间来作为ring buf，方便perf驱动写入采样数据到我们申请的mmap空间</li>
<li>开始采样，然后等待ringbuf有数据，触发我们来读取perf+pmu驱动写入的采样数据。</li>
<li>我们获取的数据有ip/tid/cpu核/callchain等，然后callchain就是调用堆栈的地址信息，通过/proc/target_pid/maps，我们可以解析出这些callchain地址属于哪个地址模块，以及这个地址模块的偏移</li>
<li>上面的地址模块+地址偏移，根据符号表，可以解析出是哪个函数，这样就得到了调用堆栈（这部分不了解不重要，这部分不是本文重点）</li>
</ol>
<br>
<br>
<br>
<br>
<h3 id="perf-内核态实现原理">perf 内核态实现原理</h3>
<hr>
<p>   一个常见的linux的驱动，基本都是在vfs上的基础上暴露相关的接口给用户使用。下面我们通过从open/mmap/ioctl等常见的接口来分析perf驱动。</p>
<br>
<br>
<h5 id="__nr_perf_event_open-实现基本原理">__NR_perf_event_open 实现基本原理</h5>
<p>  perf驱动稍微特殊一点，其不是通过vfs暴露设备节点到用户态，直接调用open来获取资源，他是直接提供了一个__NR_perf_event_open系统调用。下面简单介绍一下这个syscall的实现：</p>
<p>  代码是linux-7.1.6/kernel/events/core.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static const struct file_operations perf_fops = {
	.release		= perf_release,
	.read			= perf_read,
	.poll			= perf_poll,
	.unlocked_ioctl		= perf_ioctl,
	.compat_ioctl		= perf_compat_ioctl,
	.mmap			= perf_mmap,
	.fasync			= perf_fasync,
};


/**
 * sys_perf_event_open - open a performance event, associate it to a task/cpu
 *
 * @attr_uptr:	event_id type attributes for monitoring/sampling
 * @pid:		target pid
 * @cpu:		target cpu
 * @group_fd:		group leader event fd
 * @flags:		perf event open flags
 */
SYSCALL_DEFINE5(perf_event_open,
		struct perf_event_attr __user *, attr_uptr,
		pid_t, pid, int, cpu, int, group_fd, unsigned long, flags)
{
	struct perf_event *group_leader = NULL, *output_event = NULL;
	struct perf_event_pmu_context *pmu_ctx;
	struct perf_event *event, *sibling;
	struct perf_event_attr attr;
	struct perf_event_context *ctx;
	struct file *event_file = NULL;
	struct task_struct *task = NULL;
	struct pmu *pmu;
	int event_fd;
	int move_group = 0;
	int err;
	int f_flags = O_RDWR;
	int cgroup_fd = -1;

    // ... ...
    // 这个地方先在当前进程申请一个没有使用的fd，后面将perf的数据挂在fd上面
	event_fd = get_unused_fd_flags(f_flags);
	if (event_fd &lt; 0)
		return event_fd;

    // ... ...
    // 这个地方根据pid得到重要的进程结构体：task
	if (pid != -1 &amp;&amp; !(flags &amp; PERF_FLAG_PID_CGROUP)) {
		task = find_lively_task_by_vpid(pid);
		if (IS_ERR(task)) {
			err = PTR_ERR(task);
			goto err_fd;
		}
	}

    // ... ...

    
    /*
        这个地方是核心，后续的所有操作都是访问的这个核心结构体struct perf_event，主要做的事情是：
        1 通过	struct perf_event *event __free(__free_event) = kmem_cache_alloc_node(perf_event_cache, GFP_KERNEL | __GFP_ZERO, node);  申请内存
        2 初始化一些结构体， 设置我们传递的cpu/attr等给event保存
        3 将目标进程的task结构体保存到event-&gt;hw.target
        4 设置事件溢出时的回调：event-&gt;overflow_handler = perf_event_output_forward;（这个就是真正的写数据到ring buf的地方，后面还会提到）
        5 通过pmu = perf_init_event(event);-&gt; pmu = idr_find(&amp;pmu_idr, PERF_TYPE_RAW) 查询到对应的pmu驱动，并挂在perf_event里面。

        第5点非常重要，这里的pmu_idr是一个全局的注册表，然后可以遍历查询到对应的pmu驱动

        pmu_idr 是通过perf_pmu_register来注册的pmu驱动的，本文将以armv8 pmu驱动为例来说明
    */

	event = perf_event_alloc(&amp;attr, cpu, task, group_leader, NULL,
				 NULL, NULL, cgroup_fd);

    // ... ...

    // 这个地方：1 申请一个匿名的文件节点event_file 2 给这个event_file填写文件操作ops 3 给这个event_file填写文件private_data为event
    //              这里的作用就是，等会儿后面我们返回的fd作为句柄，然后可以通过fd来访问perf_fops里面的方法，以及前面我们构造好的event
	event_file = anon_inode_getfile("[perf_event]", &amp;perf_fops, event, f_flags);
	if (IS_ERR(event_file)) {
		err = PTR_ERR(event_file);
		event_file = NULL;
		goto err_context;
	}

    // ... ...

    // 将perf event 挂到目标进程
	perf_install_in_context(ctx, event, event-&gt;cpu);

    // ... ...

	/*
	 * File reference in group guarantees that group_leader has been
	 * kept alive until we place the new event on the sibling_list.
	 * This ensures destruction of the group leader will find
	 * the pointer to itself in perf_group_detach().
	 */
    /* 注意这个地方： 1 首先通过全局变量current获取进程对应的文件current-&gt;files。 
                    2 通过files_struct 获取fdtable(current-&gt;files-&gt;fdt)   
                    3 将event_file挂在到当前进程的fdt表中（类似：current-&gt;files-&gt;fdt[event_fd] = event_file)

        这样，当这个fd返回给用户态的程序后，我们的程序可以通过fd来调用event_file里面的perf_fops里面定义的接口。
    */
	fd_install(event_fd, event_file);
	return event_fd;

    // ... ...
}
</code></pre>
<p>  总的来说，这个syscall返回了一个fd，这个fd绑定了一个struct file 对象，这个对象的private数据域就是我们初始化的perf_event *event。这个event中包含了：与pmu驱动的关联，perf采用属性，目标进程的重要结构struct task_struct *task，perf的fops(ioctl/mmap等）等。</p>
<p>  其实这就是一个普通的驱动申请fd绑定一个私有数据、和fops的常见操作，这里绑定的就是perf_event，细节的内容见上面代码中的注释。</p>
<br>
<br>
<h5 id="perf_mmap-实现基本原理">perf_mmap 实现基本原理</h5>
<p>  在上面的demo中，我们可以知道，当perf_open完成后，我们先在需要通过mmap来申请ringbuf空间，然后我们就直接调用mmap指定空间，经过文件系统调度后，也就是上文我们的event_file中的fops中的perf_mmap.</p>
<p>   我们先看一下其实现的源码：<br>
linux-7.1.6/kernel/events/core.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static int perf_mmap(struct file *file, struct vm_area_struct *vma)
{
	struct perf_event *event = file-&gt;private_data;
	unsigned long vma_size, nr_pages;
	mapped_f mapped;
	int ret;

	/*
	 * Don't allow mmap() of inherited per-task counters. This would
	 * create a performance issue due to all children writing to the
	 * same rb.
	 */
	if (event-&gt;cpu == -1 &amp;&amp; event-&gt;attr.inherit)
		return -EINVAL;

	if (!(vma-&gt;vm_flags &amp; VM_SHARED))
		return -EINVAL;

	ret = security_perf_event_read(event);
	if (ret)
		return ret;

	vma_size = vma-&gt;vm_end - vma-&gt;vm_start;
	nr_pages = vma_size / PAGE_SIZE;

	if (nr_pages &gt; INT_MAX)
		return -ENOMEM;

	if (vma_size != PAGE_SIZE * nr_pages)
		return -EINVAL;

	scoped_guard (mutex, &amp;event-&gt;mmap_mutex) {
		/*
		 * This relies on __pmu_detach_event() taking mmap_mutex after marking
		 * the event REVOKED. Either we observe the state, or __pmu_detach_event()
		 * will detach the rb created here.
		 */
		if (event-&gt;state &lt;= PERF_EVENT_STATE_REVOKED)
			return -ENODEV;

		if (vma-&gt;vm_pgoff == 0)
			ret = perf_mmap_rb(vma, event, nr_pages);
		else
			ret = perf_mmap_aux(vma, event, nr_pages);
		if (ret)
			return ret;

		/*
		 * Since pinned accounting is per vm we cannot allow fork() to copy our
		 * vma.
		 */
		vm_flags_set(vma, VM_DONTCOPY | VM_DONTEXPAND | VM_DONTDUMP);
		vma-&gt;vm_ops = &amp;perf_mmap_vmops;

		mapped = get_mapped(event, event_mapped);
		if (mapped)
			mapped(event, vma-&gt;vm_mm);

		/*
		 * Try to map it into the page table. On fail undo the above,
		 * as the callsite expects full cleanup in this case and
		 * therefore does not invoke vmops::close().
		 */
		ret = map_range(event-&gt;rb, vma);
		if (likely(!ret))
			return 0;

		/* Error path */

		/*
		 * If this is the first mmap(), then event-&gt;mmap_count should
		 * be stable at 1. It is only modified by:
		 * perf_mmap_{open,close}() and perf_mmap().
		 *
		 * The former are not possible because this mmap() hasn't been
		 * successful yet, and the latter is serialized by
		 * event-&gt;mmap_mutex which we still hold (note that mmap_lock
		 * is not strictly sufficient here, because the event fd can
		 * be passed to another process through trivial means like
		 * fork(), leading to concurrent mmap() from different mm).
		 *
		 * Make sure to remove event-&gt;rb before releasing
		 * event-&gt;mmap_mutex, such that any concurrent mmap() will not
		 * attempt use this failed buffer.
		 */
		if (refcount_read(&amp;event-&gt;mmap_count) == 1) {
			/*
			 * Minimal perf_mmap_close(); there can't be AUX or
			 * other events on account of this being the first.
			 */
			mapped = get_mapped(event, event_unmapped);
			if (mapped)
				mapped(event, vma-&gt;vm_mm);
			perf_mmap_unaccount(vma, event-&gt;rb);
			ring_buffer_attach(event, NULL);	/* drops last rb-&gt;refcount */
			refcount_set(&amp;event-&gt;mmap_count, 0);
			return ret;
		}

		/*
		 * Otherwise this is an already existing buffer, and there is
		 * no race vs first exposure, so fall-through and call
		 * perf_mmap_close().
		 */
	}

	perf_mmap_close(vma);
	return ret;
}
</code></pre>
<p>   上面这个的核心就是通过mmap系统调用，然后调用perf_mmap，分配一片空间给perf_event，后续会使用到这片空间，其挂在event-&gt;rb中，后续根据这个来操作。</p>
<p>   注意，全程通过fd访问struct file *file，然后访问file-&gt;private_data来得到struct perf_event *event。</p>
<br>
<br>
<h5 id="armv8_pmuv3_pmu-驱动简介">armv8_pmuv3_pmu 驱动简介</h5>
<p>  首先我们介绍一下pmu是什么，pmu是Performance Monitoring Unit的简称，是可以监测硬件芯片的一些指标的功能。本文用的监测事件就是cpu执行的周期计数器。</p>
<p>  对应pmu硬件，有一个叫做pmu的驱动，这里我以我手里的设备为例，我们先来看看dts定义(从/sys/firmware/fdt解析出来的，可能和基线源码定义不一样)：</p>
<pre><code class="language-dts">{
    soc{
            cpu-pmu {
                compatible = "arm,armv8-pmuv3";
                interrupts = &lt;0x01 0x07 0x04&gt;;
                phandle = &lt;0x365&gt;;
            };
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>  然后我们来看看pmu驱动对应的初始化部分<br>
linux-7.1.6/drivers/perf/arm_pmuv3.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static struct platform_driver armv8_pmu_driver = {
	.driver		= {
		.name	= ARMV8_PMU_PDEV_NAME,
		.of_match_table = armv8_pmu_of_device_ids,
		.suppress_bind_attrs = true,
	},
	.probe		= armv8_pmu_device_probe,
};

static int __init armv8_pmu_driver_init(void)
{
	int ret;

	if (acpi_disabled)
		ret = platform_driver_register(&amp;armv8_pmu_driver);
	else
		ret = arm_pmu_acpi_probe(armv8_pmuv3_pmu_init);

	if (!ret)
		lockup_detector_retry_init();

	return ret;
}
device_initcall(armv8_pmu_driver_init)
</code></pre>
<p>  当内核启动后，platform_driver会根据dts的定义，探测相关的设备，这里调用的就是armv8_pmu_device_probe，也就是说armv8_pmu_device_probe是pmu驱动的初始化函数。</p>
<p>linux-7.1.6/drivers/perf/arm_pmuv3.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static const struct of_device_id armv8_pmu_of_device_ids[] = {
	{.compatible = "arm,armv8-pmuv3",	.data = armv8_pmuv3_pmu_init},
    // ... ...
}
static int armv8_pmu_device_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
{
	return arm_pmu_device_probe(pdev, armv8_pmu_of_device_ids, NULL);
}
static int armv8_pmu_init(struct arm_pmu *cpu_pmu, char *name,
			  int (*map_event)(struct perf_event *event))
{
	int ret = armv8pmu_probe_pmu(cpu_pmu);
	if (ret)
		return ret;

	cpu_pmu-&gt;handle_irq		= armv8pmu_handle_irq;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;enable			= armv8pmu_enable_event;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;disable		= armv8pmu_disable_event;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;read_counter		= armv8pmu_read_counter;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;write_counter		= armv8pmu_write_counter;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;get_event_idx		= armv8pmu_get_event_idx;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;clear_event_idx	= armv8pmu_clear_event_idx;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;start			= armv8pmu_start;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;stop			= armv8pmu_stop;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;reset			= armv8pmu_reset;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;set_event_filter	= armv8pmu_set_event_filter;

	cpu_pmu-&gt;pmu.event_idx		= armv8pmu_user_event_idx;
	if (brbe_num_branch_records(cpu_pmu))
		cpu_pmu-&gt;pmu.sched_task		= armv8pmu_sched_task;

	cpu_pmu-&gt;name			= name;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;map_event		= map_event;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;attr_groups[ARMPMU_ATTR_GROUP_EVENTS] = &amp;armv8_pmuv3_events_attr_group;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;attr_groups[ARMPMU_ATTR_GROUP_FORMATS] = &amp;armv8_pmuv3_format_attr_group;
	cpu_pmu-&gt;attr_groups[ARMPMU_ATTR_GROUP_CAPS] = &amp;armv8_pmuv3_caps_attr_group;
	armv8_pmu_register_sysctl_table();
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<p>linux-7.1.6/drivers/perf/arm_pmu.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">struct arm_pmu *armpmu_alloc(void)
{
	struct arm_pmu *pmu;
	int cpu;

	pmu = kzalloc_obj(*pmu);
	if (!pmu)
		goto out;

	pmu-&gt;hw_events = alloc_percpu_gfp(struct pmu_hw_events, GFP_KERNEL);
	if (!pmu-&gt;hw_events) {
		pr_info("failed to allocate per-cpu PMU data.\n");
		goto out_free_pmu;
	}

	pmu-&gt;pmu = (struct pmu) {
		.pmu_enable	= armpmu_enable,
		.pmu_disable	= armpmu_disable,
		.event_init	= armpmu_event_init,
		.add		= armpmu_add,
		.del		= armpmu_del,
		.start		= armpmu_start,
		.stop		= armpmu_stop,
		.read		= armpmu_read,
		.filter		= armpmu_filter,
		.attr_groups	= pmu-&gt;attr_groups,
		/*
		 * This is a CPU PMU potentially in a heterogeneous
		 * configuration (e.g. big.LITTLE) so
		 * PERF_PMU_CAP_EXTENDED_HW_TYPE is required to open
		 * PERF_TYPE_HARDWARE and PERF_TYPE_HW_CACHE events on a
		 * specific PMU.
		 */
		.capabilities	= PERF_PMU_CAP_EXTENDED_REGS |
				  PERF_PMU_CAP_EXTENDED_HW_TYPE,
	};

	pmu-&gt;attr_groups[ARMPMU_ATTR_GROUP_COMMON] =
		&amp;armpmu_common_attr_group;

	for_each_possible_cpu(cpu) {
		struct pmu_hw_events *events;

		events = per_cpu_ptr(pmu-&gt;hw_events, cpu);
		events-&gt;percpu_pmu = pmu;
	}

	return pmu;

out_free_pmu:
	kfree(pmu);
out:
	return NULL;
}

int armpmu_register(struct arm_pmu *pmu)
{
	int ret;

	ret = cpu_pmu_init(pmu);
	if (ret)
		return ret;

	/*
	 * By this stage we know our supported CPUs on either DT/ACPI platforms,
	 * detect the SMT implementation.
	 */
	pmu-&gt;has_smt = topology_core_has_smt(cpumask_first(&amp;pmu-&gt;supported_cpus));

	if (!pmu-&gt;set_event_filter)
		pmu-&gt;pmu.capabilities |= PERF_PMU_CAP_NO_EXCLUDE;

	ret = perf_pmu_register(&amp;pmu-&gt;pmu, pmu-&gt;name, -1);
	if (ret)
		goto out_destroy;

	pr_info("enabled with %s PMU driver, %d (%*pb) counters available%s\n",
		pmu-&gt;name, bitmap_weight(pmu-&gt;cntr_mask, ARMPMU_MAX_HWEVENTS),
		ARMPMU_MAX_HWEVENTS, &amp;pmu-&gt;cntr_mask,
		has_nmi ? ", using NMIs" : "");

	kvm_host_pmu_init(pmu);

	return 0;

out_destroy:
	cpu_pmu_destroy(pmu);
	return ret;
}
</code></pre>
<p>linux-7.1.6/drivers/perf/arm_pmu_platform.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">
int arm_pmu_device_probe(struct platform_device *pdev,
			 const struct of_device_id *of_table,
			 const struct pmu_probe_info *probe_table)
{
	armpmu_init_fn init_fn;
	struct device *dev = &amp;pdev-&gt;dev;
	struct arm_pmu *pmu;
	int ret = -ENODEV;

	pmu = armpmu_alloc();
	if (!pmu)
		return -ENOMEM;

	pmu-&gt;pmu.parent = &amp;pdev-&gt;dev;
	pmu-&gt;plat_device = pdev;

	ret = pmu_parse_irqs(pmu);
	if (ret)
		goto out_free;

	init_fn = of_device_get_match_data(dev);
	if (init_fn) {
		pmu-&gt;secure_access = of_property_read_bool(dev-&gt;of_node,
							   "secure-reg-access");

		/* arm64 systems boot only as non-secure */
		if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_ARM64) &amp;&amp; pmu-&gt;secure_access) {
			dev_warn(dev, "ignoring \"secure-reg-access\" property for arm64\n");
			pmu-&gt;secure_access = false;
		}

		ret = init_fn(pmu);
	} else if (probe_table) {
		cpumask_setall(&amp;pmu-&gt;supported_cpus);
		ret = probe_current_pmu(pmu, probe_table);
	}

	if (ret) {
		dev_err(dev, "failed to probe PMU!\n");
		goto out_free;
	}

	ret = armpmu_request_irqs(pmu);
	if (ret)
		goto out_free_irqs;

	ret = armpmu_register(pmu);
	if (ret) {
		dev_err(dev, "failed to register PMU devices!\n");
		goto out_free_irqs;
	}

	return 0;

out_free_irqs:
	armpmu_free_irqs(pmu);
out_free:
	armpmu_free(pmu);
	return ret;
}
</code></pre>
<p>  注意上面的probe函数，有几个比较重要的内容：</p>
<ol>
<li>在armpmu_alloc中，内核会申请pmu结构体，并填写几个重要的接口（struct arm_pmu-&gt;struct pmu	pmu;），比如上面我们在ioctl里面调用的pmu-add()/pmu-enable()等</li>
<li>of_device_get_match_data 获取设备表中的初始化函数：armv8_pmu_init，里面最重要的就是armv8pmu_handle_irq（这个其实就是最终的中断服务响应程序）</li>
<li>armpmu_request_irqs注册pmu中断服务程序armpmu_dispatch_irq（后面这个地方是重点，perf的采样数据就是这个地方写到mmap的空间）</li>
<li>通过armpmu_register调用perf_pmu_register注册pmu到上面的pmu_idr中。</li>
</ol>
<p>  到了这里，通过perf驱动中的pmu_idr全局变量，我们就将 armv8_pmuv3_pmu 与 perf envent驱动建立了联系。后续就可以在perf的open，ioctl等接口里面访问armv8_pmuv3_pmu。</p>
<br>
<br>
<h5 id="perf_ioctl-与-perf_event_ioc_enable">perf_ioctl 与 PERF_EVENT_IOC_ENABLE</h5>
<p>  在上一个小节，我们已经为perf_event建立了一片空间，用于输出采样数据，先在我们启动采样。和上面的mmap同样的操作，我们直接看对应的fops的ioctl，代码如下：</p>
<p>linux-7.1.6/kernel/events/core.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static long perf_ioctl(struct file *file, unsigned int cmd, unsigned long arg)
{
	struct perf_event *event = file-&gt;private_data;
	struct perf_event_context *ctx;
	long ret;

	/* Treat ioctl like writes as it is likely a mutating operation. */
	ret = security_perf_event_write(event);
	if (ret)
		return ret;

	ctx = perf_event_ctx_lock(event);
	ret = _perf_ioctl(event, cmd, arg);
	perf_event_ctx_unlock(event, ctx);

	return ret;
}

static long _perf_ioctl(struct perf_event *event, unsigned int cmd, unsigned long arg)
{
	void (*func)(struct perf_event *);
	u32 flags = arg;

	if (event-&gt;state &lt;= PERF_EVENT_STATE_REVOKED)
		return -ENODEV;

	switch (cmd) {
	case PERF_EVENT_IOC_ENABLE:
		func = _perf_event_enable;
		break;
	case PERF_EVENT_IOC_DISABLE:
		func = _perf_event_disable;
		break;

    // ... ...
    }

    // ... ... 
}

static void _perf_event_enable(struct perf_event *event)
{
	struct perf_event_context *ctx = event-&gt;ctx;

    // ... ...

	event_function_call(event, __perf_event_enable, NULL);
}

static void __perf_event_enable(struct perf_event *event,
				struct perf_cpu_context *cpuctx,
				struct perf_event_context *ctx,
				void *info)
{
	struct perf_event *leader = event-&gt;group_leader;
	struct perf_event_context *task_ctx;

    // ... ...

	ctx_resched(cpuctx, task_ctx, event-&gt;pmu_ctx-&gt;pmu, get_event_type(event));
}

// 注意ctx_resched经过多层调用后，到了event_sched_in，开启pmu采样
// ctx_resched-&gt;perf_event_sched_in-&gt; ... .... -&gt; event_sched_in

static int
event_sched_in(struct perf_event *event, struct perf_event_context *ctx)
{
	struct perf_event_pmu_context *epc = event-&gt;pmu_ctx;
	struct perf_cpu_pmu_context *cpc = this_cpc(epc-&gt;pmu);
	int ret = 0;

	WARN_ON_ONCE(event-&gt;ctx != ctx);

	lockdep_assert_held(&amp;ctx-&gt;lock);

	if (event-&gt;state &lt;= PERF_EVENT_STATE_OFF)
		return 0;

	WRITE_ONCE(event-&gt;oncpu, smp_processor_id());
	/*
	 * Order event::oncpu write to happen before the ACTIVE state is
	 * visible. This allows perf_event_{stop,read}() to observe the correct
	 * -&gt;oncpu if it sees ACTIVE.
	 */
	smp_wmb();
	perf_event_set_state(event, PERF_EVENT_STATE_ACTIVE);

	/*
	 * Unthrottle events, since we scheduled we might have missed several
	 * ticks already, also for a heavily scheduling task there is little
	 * guarantee it'll get a tick in a timely manner.
	 */
	if (unlikely(event-&gt;hw.interrupts == MAX_INTERRUPTS))
		perf_event_unthrottle(event, false);

	perf_pmu_disable(event-&gt;pmu);

	perf_log_itrace_start(event);

	if (event-&gt;pmu-&gt;add(event, PERF_EF_START)) {
		perf_event_set_state(event, PERF_EVENT_STATE_INACTIVE);
		event-&gt;oncpu = -1;
		ret = -EAGAIN;
		goto out;
	}

	if (!is_software_event(event))
		cpc-&gt;active_oncpu++;
	if (is_event_in_freq_mode(event)) {
		ctx-&gt;nr_freq++;
		epc-&gt;nr_freq++;
	}
	if (event-&gt;attr.exclusive)
		cpc-&gt;exclusive = 1;

out:
	perf_pmu_enable(event-&gt;pmu);

	return ret;
}


</code></pre>
<p>  这个ioctl + PERF_EVENT_IOC_ENABLE 主要是为了调用pmu驱动里面对应的add+enable回调。注意这里的struct pmu，在上面的perf open操作中提到了，在open中查询到对应的pmu驱动（通过perf_pmu_register来注册，本文以armv8 pmu驱动为例）。所以，这里的pmu-&gt;add(), pmu-&gt;enable()其实都是调用的对应pmu驱动的方法。</p>
<br>
<br>
<h5 id="armv8_pmuv3_pmu-中断及采样数据写入-本文核心">armv8_pmuv3_pmu 中断及采样数据写入 （本文核心）</h5>
<p>  上文，我们提到了pmu是一个硬件单元，当我们通过ioctl + PERF_EVENT_IOC_ENABLE后，pmu硬件单元就开始工作了，当采样的数据达到一定的数量是，就会触发中断。上面我们在armpmu_request_irqs中提到，中断服务程序是armpmu_dispatch_irq，我们先来看看这部分代码：</p>
<p>linux-7.1.6/drivers/perf/arm_pmu.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static irqreturn_t armpmu_dispatch_irq(int irq, void *dev)
{
	struct arm_pmu *armpmu;
	int ret;
	u64 start_clock, finish_clock;

	/*
	 * we request the IRQ with a (possibly percpu) struct arm_pmu**, but
	 * the handlers expect a struct arm_pmu*. The percpu_irq framework will
	 * do any necessary shifting, we just need to perform the first
	 * dereference.
	 */
	armpmu = *(void **)dev;
	if (WARN_ON_ONCE(!armpmu))
		return IRQ_NONE;

	start_clock = sched_clock();
	ret = armpmu-&gt;handle_irq(armpmu);
	finish_clock = sched_clock();

	perf_sample_event_took(finish_clock - start_clock);
	return ret;
}

</code></pre>
<p>  这里的armpmu-&gt;handle_irq就是armv8pmu_handle_irq，也就是中断服务程序。<br>
linux-7.1.6/drivers/perf/arm_pmuv3.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static irqreturn_t armv8pmu_handle_irq(struct arm_pmu *cpu_pmu)
{
	u64 pmovsr;
	struct perf_sample_data data;
	struct pmu_hw_events *cpuc = this_cpu_ptr(cpu_pmu-&gt;hw_events);
	struct pt_regs *regs;
	int idx;

	/*
	 * Get and reset the IRQ flags
	 */
	pmovsr = armv8pmu_getreset_flags();

	/*
	 * Did an overflow occur?
	 */
	if (!armv8pmu_has_overflowed(pmovsr))
		return IRQ_NONE;

	/*
	 * Handle the counter(s) overflow(s)
	 */
	regs = get_irq_regs();

	/*
	 * Stop the PMU while processing the counter overflows
	 * to prevent skews in group events.
	 */
	armv8pmu_stop(cpu_pmu);
	for_each_set_bit(idx, cpu_pmu-&gt;cntr_mask, ARMPMU_MAX_HWEVENTS) {
		struct perf_event *event = cpuc-&gt;events[idx];
		struct hw_perf_event *hwc;

		/* Ignore if we don't have an event. */
		if (!event)
			continue;

		/*
		 * We have a single interrupt for all counters. Check that
		 * each counter has overflowed before we process it.
		 */
		if (!armv8pmu_counter_has_overflowed(pmovsr, idx))
			continue;

		hwc = &amp;event-&gt;hw;
		armpmu_event_update(event);
		perf_sample_data_init(&amp;data, 0, hwc-&gt;last_period);
		if (!armpmu_event_set_period(event))
			continue;

		if (has_branch_stack(event))
			read_branch_records(cpuc, event, &amp;data);

		/*
		 * Perf event overflow will queue the processing of the event as
		 * an irq_work which will be taken care of in the handling of
		 * IPI_IRQ_WORK.
		 */
		perf_event_overflow(event, &amp;data, regs);
	}
	armv8pmu_start(cpu_pmu);

	return IRQ_HANDLED;
}
</code></pre>
<p>  这个中断服务程序的核心就是，先关闭pmu硬件功能，然后根据当前的pmu的寄存器数据，初始化perf_sample_data，然后调用perf_event_overflow进行处理。<br>
linux-7.1.6/kernel/events/core.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">int perf_event_overflow(struct perf_event *event,
			struct perf_sample_data *data,
			struct pt_regs *regs)
{
	/*
	 * Entry point from hardware PMI, interrupts should be disabled here.
	 * This serializes us against perf_event_remove_from_context() in
	 * things like perf_event_release_kernel().
	 */
	lockdep_assert_irqs_disabled();

	return __perf_event_overflow(event, 1, data, regs);
}

static int __perf_event_overflow(struct perf_event *event,
				 int throttle, struct perf_sample_data *data,
				 struct pt_regs *regs)
{
	int events = atomic_read(&amp;event-&gt;event_limit);
	int ret = 0;

	/*
	 * Non-sampling counters might still use the PMI to fold short
	 * hardware counters, ignore those.
	 */
	if (unlikely(!is_sampling_event(event)))
		return 0;

	ret = __perf_event_account_interrupt(event, throttle);

	if (event-&gt;attr.aux_pause)
		perf_event_aux_pause(event-&gt;aux_event, true);

	if (event-&gt;prog &amp;&amp; event-&gt;prog-&gt;type == BPF_PROG_TYPE_PERF_EVENT &amp;&amp;
	    !bpf_overflow_handler(event, data, regs))
		goto out;

	/*
	 * XXX event_limit might not quite work as expected on inherited
	 * events
	 */

	event-&gt;pending_kill = POLL_IN;
	if (events &amp;&amp; atomic_dec_and_test(&amp;event-&gt;event_limit)) {
		ret = 1;
		event-&gt;pending_kill = POLL_HUP;
		perf_event_disable_inatomic(event);
		event-&gt;pmu-&gt;stop(event, 0);
	}

	if (event-&gt;attr.sigtrap) {
		/*
		 * The desired behaviour of sigtrap vs invalid samples is a bit
		 * tricky; on the one hand, one should not loose the SIGTRAP if
		 * it is the first event, on the other hand, we should also not
		 * trigger the WARN or override the data address.
		 */
		bool valid_sample = sample_is_allowed(event, regs);
		unsigned int pending_id = 1;
		enum task_work_notify_mode notify_mode;

		if (regs)
			pending_id = hash32_ptr((void *)instruction_pointer(regs)) ?: 1;

		notify_mode = in_nmi() ? TWA_NMI_CURRENT : TWA_RESUME;

		if (!event-&gt;pending_work &amp;&amp;
		    !task_work_add(current, &amp;event-&gt;pending_task, notify_mode)) {
			event-&gt;pending_work = pending_id;
			local_inc(&amp;event-&gt;ctx-&gt;nr_no_switch_fast);
			WARN_ON_ONCE(!atomic_long_inc_not_zero(&amp;event-&gt;refcount));

			event-&gt;pending_addr = 0;
			if (valid_sample &amp;&amp; (data-&gt;sample_flags &amp; PERF_SAMPLE_ADDR))
				event-&gt;pending_addr = data-&gt;addr;

		} else if (event-&gt;attr.exclude_kernel &amp;&amp; valid_sample) {
			/*
			 * Should not be able to return to user space without
			 * consuming pending_work; with exceptions:
			 *
			 *  1. Where !exclude_kernel, events can overflow again
			 *     in the kernel without returning to user space.
			 *
			 *  2. Events that can overflow again before the IRQ-
			 *     work without user space progress (e.g. hrtimer).
			 *     To approximate progress (with false negatives),
			 *     check 32-bit hash of the current IP.
			 */
			WARN_ON_ONCE(event-&gt;pending_work != pending_id);
		}
	}

	READ_ONCE(event-&gt;overflow_handler)(event, data, regs);

	if (*perf_event_fasync(event) &amp;&amp; event-&gt;pending_kill) {
		event-&gt;pending_wakeup = 1;
		irq_work_queue(&amp;event-&gt;pending_irq);
	}
out:
	if (event-&gt;attr.aux_resume)
		perf_event_aux_pause(event-&gt;aux_event, false);

	return ret;
}
</code></pre>
<p>  然后通过event-&gt;overflow_handler写入采样数据到mmap申请的内存空间（我们上面在open的时候提到了，这里的溢出处理handler就是perf_event_output_forward）。</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">void
perf_event_output_forward(struct perf_event *event,
			 struct perf_sample_data *data,
			 struct pt_regs *regs)
{
	__perf_event_output(event, data, regs, perf_output_begin_forward);
}

static __always_inline int
__perf_event_output(struct perf_event *event,
		    struct perf_sample_data *data,
		    struct pt_regs *regs,
		    int (*output_begin)(struct perf_output_handle *,
					struct perf_sample_data *,
					struct perf_event *,
					unsigned int))
{
	struct perf_output_handle handle;
	struct perf_event_header header;
	int err;

	/* protect the callchain buffers */
	rcu_read_lock();

	perf_prepare_sample(data, event, regs);
	perf_prepare_header(&amp;header, data, event, regs);

	err = output_begin(&amp;handle, data, event, header.size);
	if (err)
		goto exit;

	perf_output_sample(&amp;handle, &amp;header, data, event);

	perf_output_end(&amp;handle);

exit:
	rcu_read_unlock();
	return err;
}
</code></pre>
<p>  在__perf_event_output中：</p>
<ol>
<li>perf_prepare_sample 从寄存器中准备采样数据</li>
<li>perf_prepare_header 准备采样数据的头。</li>
<li>根据上面的header，通过output_begin 在event-&gt;rb的ringbuf中申请当前这个样本的数据空间</li>
<li>然后perf_output_sample开始写入。</li>
</ol>
<p>  在perf_output_end中，我们需要通知用户态的poll可以返回了，现在有数据可以返回了。</p>
<p>linux-7.1.6/kernel/events/ring_buffer.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">void perf_output_end(struct perf_output_handle *handle)
{
	perf_output_put_handle(handle);
	rcu_read_unlock();
}


static void perf_output_put_handle(struct perf_output_handle *handle)
{
	struct perf_buffer *rb = handle-&gt;rb;
	unsigned long head;
	unsigned int nest;

    // ... ...

	if (handle-&gt;wakeup != local_read(&amp;rb-&gt;wakeup))
		perf_output_wakeup(handle);

out:
	preempt_enable();
}

static void perf_output_wakeup(struct perf_output_handle *handle)
{
	atomic_set(&amp;handle-&gt;rb-&gt;poll, EPOLLIN | EPOLLRDNORM);

	handle-&gt;event-&gt;pending_wakeup = 1;

	if (*perf_event_fasync(handle-&gt;event) &amp;&amp; !handle-&gt;event-&gt;pending_kill)
		handle-&gt;event-&gt;pending_kill = POLL_IN;

	irq_work_queue(&amp;handle-&gt;event-&gt;pending_irq);
}
</code></pre>
<p>  注意，perf_output_end 还是在pmu中断服务程序内部调用的，为了异步交付数据给用户态，这里给软中断发送一个中断请求，中断服务地址是：event-&gt;pending_irq ，也就是perf_pending_irq，这个是在open的过程中， 初始化指定的。</p>
<p>linux-7.1.6/kernel/events/ring_buffer.c</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static void perf_pending_irq(struct irq_work *entry)
{
	struct perf_event *event = container_of(entry, struct perf_event, pending_irq);
	int rctx;

	/*
	 * If we 'fail' here, that's OK, it means recursion is already disabled
	 * and we won't recurse 'further'.
	 */
	rctx = perf_swevent_get_recursion_context();

	/*
	 * The wakeup isn't bound to the context of the event -- it can happen
	 * irrespective of where the event is.
	 */
	if (event-&gt;pending_wakeup) {
		event-&gt;pending_wakeup = 0;
		perf_event_wakeup(event);
	}

	if (rctx &gt;= 0)
		perf_swevent_put_recursion_context(rctx);
}

void perf_event_wakeup(struct perf_event *event)
{
	ring_buffer_wakeup(event);

	if (event-&gt;pending_kill) {
		kill_fasync(perf_event_fasync(event), SIGIO, event-&gt;pending_kill);
		event-&gt;pending_kill = 0;
	}
}

static void ring_buffer_wakeup(struct perf_event *event)
{
	struct perf_buffer *rb;

	if (event-&gt;parent)
		event = event-&gt;parent;

	rcu_read_lock();
	rb = rcu_dereference(event-&gt;rb);
	if (rb) {
		list_for_each_entry_rcu(event, &amp;rb-&gt;event_list, rb_entry)
			wake_up_all(&amp;event-&gt;waitq);
	}
	rcu_read_unlock();
}


static __poll_t perf_poll(struct file *file, poll_table *wait)
{
	struct perf_event *event = file-&gt;private_data;
	struct perf_buffer *rb;
	__poll_t events = EPOLLHUP;

	if (event-&gt;state &lt;= PERF_EVENT_STATE_REVOKED)
		return EPOLLERR;

	poll_wait(file, &amp;event-&gt;waitq, wait);

	if (event-&gt;state &lt;= PERF_EVENT_STATE_REVOKED)
		return EPOLLERR;

	if (is_event_hup(event))
		return events;

	if (unlikely(READ_ONCE(event-&gt;state) == PERF_EVENT_STATE_ERROR &amp;&amp;
		     event-&gt;attr.pinned))
		return EPOLLERR;

	/*
	 * Pin the event-&gt;rb by taking event-&gt;mmap_mutex; otherwise
	 * perf_event_set_output() can swizzle our rb and make us miss wakeups.
	 */
	mutex_lock(&amp;event-&gt;mmap_mutex);
	rb = event-&gt;rb;
	if (rb)
		events = atomic_xchg(&amp;rb-&gt;poll, 0);
	mutex_unlock(&amp;event-&gt;mmap_mutex);
	return events;
}

</code></pre>
<p>  注意，通过perf_pending_irq，我们调用到了ring_buffer_wakeup，我们可以wake_up_all(&amp;event-&gt;waitq)所有等待队列上面的进程，每个进程自己检查，是否有poll数据了，我们在软中断中标记了handle-&gt;rb-&gt;poll为有数据。。</p>
<br>
<br>
<br>
<br>
<h3 id="后记">后记</h3>
<hr>
<p>  总的来说，perf的工作原理（以采集cpu cycle为例）大概如下：</p>
<ol>
<li>cpu有一个叫做pmu的硬件监测单元，因此设备平台编写了一个叫做pmu的平台驱动，本文是：armv8_pmuv3_pmu驱动。在内核启动的时候，根据dts的定义，自动探测到armv8_pmuv3_pmu驱动，并将pmu驱动注册到perf驱动中的pmu_idr全局变量中。</li>
<li>用户通过__NR_perf_event_open 系统调用创建一个struct perf_event，绑定armv8_pmuv3_pmu驱动，然后绑定给一个struct file，并给struct file装载各种fops的实现（例如：ioctl/mmap/poll等）。</li>
<li>用户通过mmap访问perf_mmap，然后将申请的vm挂在到struct perf_event-&gt;rb中</li>
<li>用户通过ioctl+PERF_EVENT_IOC_ENABLE，通过struct perf_event-&gt;pmu里面的相关ops，设置pmu，然后开启pmu中断</li>
<li>pmu中断开始响应，将采样数据写入到struct perf_event-&gt;rb中，标记了struct perf_event-&gt;rb-&gt;poll有数据，然后发出一个新的irq软中断，pmu中断结束。</li>
<li>在perf_pending_irq中，唤醒struct perf_event-&gt;waitq上面的所有进程，irq软中断结束。</li>
<li>在perf_poll中，由于vfs poll的实现原理，在反复调用perf_poll，当我们通过软中断唤醒所有等待队列的进程后，再次调用perf_poll，然后检查struct perf_event-&gt;rb-&gt;poll，然后返回用户态，用户态开始处理新的采样数据，然后返回。</li>
</ol>
<p>  完结散花。</p>
<h3 id="参考文献">参考文献</h3>
<ul>
<li>无</li>
</ul>
